title: Prevent path traversal in the static file resolver
instruction: resolveStaticPath(root, requestPath) in src/static.mjs maps a URL path to a file path under the absolute directory root. Make it safe: percent-decode requestPath (malformed encoding throws RangeError), reject NUL bytes, treat both '/' and '\\' as separators, reject absolute or drive-qualified paths after decoding, and return null whenever the resolved path is not root itself or inside root (including sibling directories that merely share root's name as a prefix, such as '/srv/app' vs '/srv/app-secrets'). Otherwise return the resolved absolute path (use node:path resolve). Do not touch the filesystem.

acceptanceCriteria: '..' traversal returns null, also when percent-encoded or with backslashes
absolute and drive paths return null
